method.method_draft: Read the image as a vertical addition problem with top number P45, bottom number QRS, and sum 654. Use right-to-left column addition with carries: in the ones column, 5 + S ends in 4, so S = 9 and carry 1. In the tens column, 4 + R + 1 ends in 5, so R = 0 and no carry. In the hundreds column, P + Q must equal 6. Therefore P+Q+R+S = 6+0+9 = 15.
